# Project Overview

This analysis investigates cross-price elasticity and cannibalization effects between iPhone 15 and iPhone 16 Pro.

# 1. Environment Setup

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

setwd("C:\\Users\\alexa\\OneDrive\\ドキュメント\\R EDA")
```

# 2. Data Loading

```{r}
sales_data <- read_excel("smartphone_sales.xlsx")
sales_data$Date <- as.Date(sales_data$Date)
head(sales_data)
```

# 3. Elasticity Function

```{r}
calculate_elasticity <- function(data, baseline_start, baseline_end, sale_start, sale_end, event_name) {
  baseline_data <- subset(data, Date >= as.Date(baseline_start) & Date <= as.Date(baseline_end))

  base_price_15 <- mean(subset(baseline_data, Model == "iPhone 15")$Final_Price)
  base_qty_16 <- mean(subset(baseline_data, Model == "iPhone 16 Pro")$Quantity_Sold)

  sale_data <- subset(data, Date >= as.Date(sale_start) & Date <= as.Date(sale_end))

  sale_price_15 <- mean(subset(sale_data, Model == "iPhone 15")$Final_Price)
  sale_qty_16 <- mean(subset(sale_data, Model == "iPhone 16 Pro")$Quantity_Sold)

  pct_change_price_15 <- (sale_price_15 - base_price_15) / base_price_15
  pct_change_qty_16 <- (sale_qty_16 - base_qty_16) / base_qty_16

  elasticity <- pct_change_qty_16 / pct_change_price_15

  print(paste("---", event_name, "---"))
  print(paste("Cross-Price Elasticity:", round(elasticity, 2)))

  if(elasticity > 0) {
    print("Status: Cannibalization Confirmed.")
  } else {
    print("Status: No Cannibalization.")
  }
}
```

# 4. Event 1

```{r}
calculate_elasticity(sales_data, "2024-01-01", "2024-02-08",
                     "2024-02-09", "2024-02-29",
                     "Event 1: Valentine's Sale")
```

# 5. Event 2

```{r}
calculate_elasticity(sales_data, "2024-03-01", "2024-05-09",
                     "2024-05-10", "2024-05-29",
                     "Event 2: Summer Sale")
```

# 6. Visualization

```{r}
ggplot(sales_data, aes(x = Date, y = Quantity_Sold, color = Model)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-02-09"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-02-29"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-05-10"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date("2024-05-29"), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cannibalization Analysis",
       x = "Date",
       y = "Units Sold")
```

# Conclusion

Positive elasticity indicates cannibalization between products.
